name: WHOOP
short_desc: External: connect WHOOP so Health and your agent get your recovery, sleep, strain and workouts (read-only).
author: Humanity Labs
description: Connect your WHOOP with a guided setup inside the app. The app keeps a private synced copy and offers it read-only to other apps on this box through the health-data contract; the Health app shows today, trends and workouts. Keys and sign-in stay in the app.
